title: Tiny, cute bowl of noodles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bowl shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  
  <!-- Bowl body -->
  <path d='M18 55 Q18 88 50 88 Q82 88 82 55 Z' fill='#e85d4a'/>
  <path d='M18 55 Q18 60 50 62 Q82 60 82 55 Z' fill='#ff7b6b'/>
  
  <!-- Bowl rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='32' ry='8' fill='#ff9f8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#c94433'/>
  
  <!-- Broth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#f5c542'/>
  
  <!-- Noodles - wavy lines -->
  <path d='M30 53 Q35 48 38 53 Q41 58 44 53' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 56 Q47 51 50 56 Q53 61 56 56' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 52 Q59 47 62 52 Q65 57 68 52' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 58 Q41 53 44 58 Q47 63 50 58' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 50 Q53 45 56 50 Q59 55 62 50' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Egg half -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' fill='#ffcc00'/>
  
  <!-- Green onion slices -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='53' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#5dbb46'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='57' rx='1.8' ry='1.3' fill='#5dbb46'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='56' rx='1.8' ry='1.3' fill='#5dbb46'/>
  
  <!-- Chopsticks -->
  <line x1='60' y1='20' x2='78' y2='50' stroke='#d4a056' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='18' x2='80' y2='48' stroke='#e8b86d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Steam -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q35 36 38 30' stroke='#dddddd' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 40 Q47 33 50 26' stroke='#dddddd' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M62 42 Q59 36 62 30' stroke='#dddddd' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Cute face on bowl -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#3a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#3a1a10'/>
  <path d='M45 76 Q50 80 55 76' stroke='#3a1a10' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='74' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='74' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
